g.text: Notes: Precision and recall use true-positive attack windows. FPR = false positives / all true-negative windows; FP and FN are window counts.
Benign episodes alerted = number of entirely benign episodes with at least one alert / 75; this is not the same quantity as window-level FPR.
Synthetic NAF v2 development validation, 18,839 overlapping decision windows. Thresholds 0.20 and 0.50 are illustrative operating points, not optimized deployment settings.
